title.zh: 将马尼拉大都会Las Piñas市镇Pulanglupa II描笼涯的Las Piñas北区市镇中学改设为独立中学，名称为Las Piñas北区国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Las Piñas North Municipal High School in Barangay Pulanglupa Ii, Municipality of Las Piñas, Metro Manila, Into An Independent High School, To Be Known As the Las Piñas North National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Las Piñas North Municipal High School in Barangay Pulanglupa II, Las Piñas, Metro Manila, shall be converted into an independent high school to be known as the Las Piñas North National High School.

All the assets, movable and immovable, records and personnel of the Las Piñas North Municipal High School, as well its liabilities or obligations, are hereby transferred to the Las Piñas North National High School: Provided, however, That the positions, rights and security of tenure of personnel therein employed under existing laws are not impaired.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
